title: security: rbac v2 enforcement + audit logging + KMS region pinning
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Enforce RBAC v2 policies at request-routing time, ensure comprehensive audit logging for KMS usage and data residency decisions, and add region-pinning constraints so keys/resources cannot be used outside allowed regions. This PR implements the enforcement path (not just audit mode) for RBAC v2, wires audit events to the new audit-log sink with KMS context, and adds a pluggable policy check that validates KMS key residency and request region pinning before allowing sensitive operations. Checklist: [x] Implement RBAC v2 enforcement in auth proxy, [x] Add audit-log entries with KMS key id and region, [x] Add policy for KMS region pinning + residency checks, [x] Add unit and integration tests, [x] E2E validation against staging KMS simulator, [x] Add docs/upgrade notes and migration guidance. Related linear: ENG-4521, security review SEC-1198. Related docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/rbac-v2, https://docs.redwood.ai/compliance/kms-region-pinning. Notes: this replaces the previous audit-only gating (PR ENG-3988) with operational enforcement while preserving a migration toggle (rbac.v2.enforce=true) and a soft-fail fallback to allow gradual rollout. The KMS residency check is pluggable via the kms/residency interface to support AWS, GCP, and customer on-prem KMS adapters.
